name: Multi-texture Mapping Splatting
aliases: Accelerating splatting algorithm based on multi-texture mapping
Texture-mapped Splatting (Crawfis and Max; Yagel et al.)
definition: A volume rendering algorithm that accelerates footprint-based splatting by dividing the volume data into texture slices along the primary viewing direction, projecting voxels to these slices, and blending them using hardware-assisted multi-texture mapping to reduce depth sorting complexity.
